title: Beauty box for clowns?
text:
My eyes are still recovering from the sight of myself after I tried on the day-glo pink lipstick in this month’s beauty box. Maybe it will be compatible with last month’s neon orange lipstick, or the orange eyeshadow from the month before.

I like the sample skin and hair care products, and I know it’s tough to figure out which makeup will look good on many people. But let’s start with not choosing day-glo colors unless these boxes are headed to a troupe of clowns. Come on, people!
